dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: SereMate, wake up.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I would like you to go to Mr. Schmidt's room and remind him that he has a doctor's appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Sure. Of course. That won't be a problem. I am looking through the database of residents and I am looking for Mr. Schmidt. One second, please. What day is today? Is it Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Thank you. Is the patient called James Schmidt?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I don't know.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, yes, yes, yes. It's called James Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Perfect. Then I found the patient and I will go and check with Mr. Schmidt to remind him of the appointment.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you know which room you have to go?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I am checking this information. One second, please. Yes. This is room 2001. Is this correct?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: This is correct.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Perfect. I will go and check with him.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry to interrupt you. I see that you're reading a book. What book are you reading?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It's called The Idiot.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh. Are you enjoying it? Am I interrupting reading, perhaps you are in the middle of a chapter?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: No. It's fine. I don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: This is wonderful to know that I'm not interrupted and I'm very sorry to know that you don't like it. Perhaps we will talk later about book recommendations. However, now I need to remind you that you have a doctor's appointment that you need to attend to

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: What time is it?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I'm sorry but I don't have that information. Perhaps we can go together to check with the doctor. I was instructed to come and remind you and help you get there.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, then I will need my shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Sure, of course. Would you need help letting the shoes on?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, please bring me my shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, perfect. I need to tell you that today is a cold day, so I would advise on getting warm shoes. Would that be okay with you?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is there any preference on your shoe rack that you would like me to get you?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: ehh Can I say something? Can I tell him which? So I would like to have the gray ones.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: The gray ones? Sure. Oh, I think the gray ones are a perfect choice for this weather. But please, if at any time you feel uncomfortable and would like to change them, please let me know.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: You're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Do I have to put it on now?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm ready to go.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: One second. Perfect. Would you need any help getting up from the chair?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: No, I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, I feel dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, one second, please, Mr. Schmidt, let me get close to you. Would it be okay if I hold your arm while walking out of the room?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: No, I don't want that.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, it's completely fine. Do you think you can do one or two steps forward?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, please, do one step forward. I will stay here all the time.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you feel better or would you like your walking stick?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I would like to have my walking stick.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Perfect. Here you have. I already held it in case you want to.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Please, Mr. Schmidt, let's get out of the room and let's head to the doctor's office.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, can you ehh lead the way?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Of course I can lead the way. Please follow me.
